meta.name: istio-traffic-management
meta.description: Configure Istio traffic management including routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, and canary deployments. Use when implementing service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery, or resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 配置服务网格流量路由与渐进式发布策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用服务网格管理服务间流量,需要安全地滚动发布。
copy.tagline_en: Configure service mesh traffic policies for routing and progressive rollouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage service mesh traffic and need safe progressive delivery.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Istio 规范生成流量管理 YAML：VirtualService 路由、DestinationRule 策略、金丝雀发布、熔断与重试、流量镜像、故障注入、入口网关，并给出 istioctl 排查命令。
howto.when: 当你要配置服务间路由、实施金丝雀或蓝绿发布，或设置熔断与重试时触发；也可用于负载均衡、流量镜像等场景。

say.text: 给 ratings 服务加 10 秒超时和 3 次重试
用 istioctl 查看 my-app 的有效路由和端点
say.note: 给出对应的 istioctl proxy-config 命令

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes Istio traffic-management YAML: VirtualService routing, DestinationRule policies, canary rollouts, circuit breakers, retries, mirroring, fault injection and ingress gateways, plus istioctl debug commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you configure service-to-service routing, canary or blue-green rollouts, or circuit breakers and retries; also covers load balancing and traffic mirroring.

say_en.text: Write a canary setup for reviews: 90% stable, 10% canary
Add a 10s timeout and 3 retries to ratings
say_en.note: Generates a VirtualService with timeout and retries

say_en.text: Show my-app routes and endpoints with istioctl
say_en.note: Gives the matching istioctl proxy-config commands
